items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.who: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
items.q: My aunt Ophelia, Ophelia, Ophelia prison.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He was a mother's sister, Ophelia. He was a mother's sister, Ophelia. And he went away. My aunt Ophelia, Ophelia, Ophelia prison. And he went away. She was four years old. When my uncle George left my aunt, his child was four years old.
My uncle George had four children, but they all died and birthed. And all boys were stuck with them.
